name: legends-geogrid
description: Open-source google maps rank checker with geo-grid scans, an interactive map studio, PDF reports, and DataForSEO cost controls.
author: Avalon Reset

scripts.dryrun:sample: python tools/bulk_geogrid_runner.py --prospects examples/sample-prospects.csv --run-id sample-dryrun --output-root bulk-runs --method standard --grid-size 5 --radius-km 2 --depth 20 --zoom 15
scripts.check: pnpm audit --prod --audit-level high && pnpm build && pnpm check:python && pnpm test && pnpm doctor:reports && pnpm dryrun:sample && pnpm check:reports
